# Phase

Group: Data. Import: `import { Phase } from 'lynn-ui';`

## Props
 ```ts interface PhaseProps {   /** `active` - blue dot, pulsing at 2s. `next` - emerald dot, pulsing slower at 2.5s so two live phases are distinguishable  */   status?: "active" | "shipped" | "next" | "future";   title: React.ReactNode;   /** The phase's window, e.g. `Q3 2026`. */   period?: React.ReactNode;   description?: React.ReactNode;   /** What has to land first. Renders as the source's `Requires:`-prefixed chip, so callers pass only the dependency itself. */   dependency?: React.ReactNode;   /** The phase's `RoadmapItemCard`s, laid out in a responsive grid. */   children?: React.ReactNode;   /** Anchor id, so a DocRail section link can jump to this phase. */   id?: string;   className?: string;   style?: CSSProperties; } ```

## Props

- `status?: PhaseStatus` - `active` - blue dot, pulsing at 2s. `next` - emerald dot, pulsing slower at 2.5s so two live phases are distinguishable at a glance. `shipped` - solid emerald dot, no motion. `future` - faint neutral dot.
- `title: ReactNode`
- `period?: ReactNode` - The phase's window, e.g. `Q3 2026`.
- `description?: ReactNode`
- `dependency?: ReactNode` - What has to land first. Renders as the source's `Requires:`-prefixed chip, so callers pass only the dependency itself.
- `children?: ReactNode` - The phase's `RoadmapItemCard`s, laid out in a responsive grid.
- `id?: string` - Anchor id, so a DocRail section link can jump to this phase.
- `className?: string`
- `style?: CSSProperties`
